change: Deduplicate status expiry projections, traverse sparse burn dirtiness, and allocate shared snapshot containers only on change.
implementation: Working tree based on 37c1a44; production edits limited to StatusSystem, BurnSystem and ShareSnapshot.

decisions.status: Retain bounded dirty target lists and publish before the next stage; application, death and shield consumption remain immediate.
decisions.burn: Remove the JavaScript full-capacity dirty scan; dense cost is essentially unchanged, sparse events save microseconds after warmup. Keep native dueGroups.fill and deterministic hit sorting.
decisions.snapshot: Lazy result allocation preserves structural sharing and immutable inputs. Recursive key/value comparison remains; no domain-version wire protocol is introduced.
decisions.render: Retain full component TypedArray.set and the slot-indexed transferable protocol. Sparse writes lose at 256/896 slots. Returned buffers require new views because transfer detaches old views.
decisions.limits: No browser before/after FPS claim. Browser capture is one machine, one 128-enemy workload and 15 seconds; no full-capacity 896-enemy GPU or long-session guarantee. Snapshot microbench excludes structured clone; status/burn timing excludes setup. Dense burn variation is not reported as a speedup.

paired.scope: Node CPU only; expiry setup and snapshot structured clone excluded; render roundtrip uses synchronous structuredClone, not browser scheduling or GPU; copy kernels do not compact the protocol.

context.timing: one warmup, five samples, simulation only; travel/terrain restore health between ticks while retaining hit settlement; no browser/GPU claim

mixedBrowser.scope: Chromium ANGLE D3D11; 128 durable mixed enemies plus normal regional residency; valid level-1000 three-school build; 8s warmup, 15s capture; alternating movement/rest; vitals replenished before each tick; production cast/AI/hit/Worker/render path. Diagnostic GPU values are asynchronous timer samples when supported, not inferred from FPS.

validation.replay: 1200 ticks: exact full checkpoint and snapshot equality, including revision and random state
